approve.title: Approve {{name}}?
approve.description: We'll finish setup and {{owner}} can sign in as Owner.

reject.title: Reject {{name}}?
reject.description: The organization will be closed and we'll notify {{email}}. Their personal account will keep working.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.description: Nobody can enter the organization while it is suspended, and its open sessions will be closed. Its members' personal profiles will keep working.

reactivate.description: Its members can sign in again with the same roles.

close.title: Close {{name}}?
close.description: This cannot be undone. Its data will be retained until purging and nobody can enter again.
